2116768459451469945.en_summary: CZ of Binance: US Law Enforcement agencies (FBI, USSS, IRS and more) provided vital help in this incident, including tracking, freezing, etc. A tweet can’t fully express our gratitude. Many crypto bros may not realize, a lot of the "why bitcoin didn't drop more?" credit goes to them. (Quoted FBI: North Korea responsible for theft of more than $6 billion USD in virtual assets from Binance on or about October 29, 2026, converting primarily into ETH.)
2116768459451469945.zh_summary: Binance的CZ：美國執法機構（FBI、USSS、IRS等）在此事件中提供了重要幫助，包括追蹤、凍結等。一條推文無法充分表達我們的感激。許多加密貨幣愛好者可能沒有意識到，「為什麼比特幣沒有跌得更多？」的很大功勞歸功於他們。（引用FBI：朝鮮負責2026年10月29日左右從Binance盜竊超過60億美元的虛擬資產，主要轉換為ETH。）

2116767152174948394.en_summary: (Reposted by @cz_binance) Phase 1 of withdrawals reopens @binance today, from 06:00–09:00 UTC, covering 15 networks. Not all 15 open at once but come back progressively to manage traffic volume, so expect a more bumpy experience in the beginning and gets smoother closer to 09:00 UTC. #USDT is live on nine of them including TRC20, ERC20 and BEP20. If withdrawal stalls in first hours, likely congestion from traffic volume, not a block. Give it a few minutes and retry. Everything else returns as each network and asset clears repeated security checks, prioritized by usage this past week.
2116767152174948394.zh_summary: （由@cz_binance轉發）@binance今天從UTC 06:00–09:00重新開放第一階段提款，涵蓋15個網絡。不是全部15個同時開放，而是逐步恢復以管理流量，因此初期體驗較為顛簇，接近09:00 UTC會更順暢。#USDT在其中九個網絡上線，包括TRC20、ERC20和BEP20。如果提款在最初幾小時停滯，很可能是流量擁堵而非封鎖。等幾分鐘再重試。其他一切將隨著每個網絡和資產通過重複安全檢查而恢復，優先考慮過去一週的使用情況。

2116787323266359551.zh_summary: #GermanyWatch：Chris Wood在《Greed & Fear》中報告，德國的天然氣價格是美國人支付的11倍。令人震驚的是，Merz繼續將德國的國內問題置於對烏克蘭支持的奇怪執念之下。難怪Merz的支持已經完全崩潰。

2116778807499821175.en_summary: Gold had a steep fall on Friday and is back below 4,000. Gold has had a negative correlation with oil since the war began. A 10% rise in Brent implies a 4% drop in gold. An imminent return to a "hot" war will weigh on gold a bit, but downside is limited.
2116778807499821175.zh_summary: 黃金週五大幅下跌，回落至4,000以下。自戰爭開始以來，黃金與石油呈負相關。布蘭特原油上漲10%意味著黃金下跌4%。即將重返「熱戰」會對黃金造成一些壓力，但下跌空間有限。

2116571020857581818.en_summary: MIDDLE EAST OIL FLOWS: With data for Oct 1-26, Middle Eastern crude exports (ex Iran) are on track to be higher in Oct than in Sept (and very close to pre-war levels >90% for the monthly average). After weeks of attacks against tankers and infrastructure, Iran and its proxies have failed to stop the flow. But all that recovery could be gone if the war re-starts after Nov. 3. Crude flows include SoH plus all bypass routes. Flows of clean and dirty refined products remain depressed, holding around >60% of pre-war levels (ex Iran).
2116571020857581818.zh_summary: 中東石油流量：根據10月1-26日數據，中東原油出口（不包括伊朗）10月有望高於9月（月平均非常接近戰前水平>90%）。經過數週對油輪和基礎設施的攻擊，伊朗及其代理人未能阻止流量。但如果戰爭在11月3日後重啟，所有這些復甦都可能消失。原油流量包括SoH加上所有繞道。清潔和髒污精煉產品的流量仍然低迷，保持在戰前水平的>60%左右（不包括伊朗）。
